content.title: Bilkis Bano: Icon of Resilience in the Face of Injustice
content.caption: Bilkis Bano, a survivor of the 2002 Gujarat riots, has emerged as an icon of resilience in the fight for justice.

slides.heading: Bilkis Bano: Icon of Resilience in the Face of Injustice
slides.text: Bilkis Bano, a survivor of the 2002 Gujarat riots, has emerged as an icon of resilience in the fight for justice.

slides.heading: Life Story
slides.text: Bilkis Bano's life story includes being gang-raped and losing seven members of her family, including her three-year-old daughter, in the 2002 Gujarat riots.

slides.heading: Legal Battle for Justice
slides.text: Bilkis Bano's prolonged legal battle for justice has inspired women worldwide, and her husband, Patel Yakub Rasool, recounted the long and arduous struggle for justice she had to wage.
